sentences.text: Cold Water Club Oy is a company registered on 2026-07-31 under the industry code 93290, amusement and recreation activities.
First sales, a start-up notification and a board change are all dated 2026-07-31.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a water word but the registered industry is recreation and the record shows no ocean technology.
